coverage_summary.unsearched_systems_note: The frozen target list is a closed list of 14 named systems; every entry was searched. The unsearched space is the published literature outside that list, which prereg 4.4 delegates to a bounded snowball. The snowball was ATTEMPTED and yielded 0 usable candidates (raw/references/snowball_candidates.json): the PC artifact's reference list prints no arXiv identifiers, so the frozen inclusion rule ('reference strings that contain an arXiv identifier') selects nothing.

metrics.declared_vs_actual_cost: prereg section 12 estimated ~200 network requests and ~300 wall-clock seconds; actual 32 HTTP attempts and 152 s of retrieval. Both inside the estimate, so no cost threat to the frozen design.
metrics.outcome_mapping_note: research/EXPERIMENT_PACKET.md section 4 separates measurement validity (status) from the scientific answer (outcome). The frozen decision rule in spec.json decision_rule and prereg.md section 8 names MEASUREMENT_INVALID as an OUTCOME value; the packet contract encodes that as status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Because the frozen gates fire before any scientific verdict may be assigned, the packet-level outcome is NOT_APPLICABLE: none of SUPPORTS/FALSIFIES/MIXED/INCONCLUSIVE is licensed for the experiment as a whole. The frozen per-part rule outputs are preserved verbatim in part1_outcome / part2_outcome / part3_outcome / overall_outcome below.
p2_conventions_observed: WebArena/WebVoyager: end-to-end or task-level Success Rate judged on functional correctness, no step optimality (shared convention by explicit design)
Mind2Web: Step Success Rate and whole-task Success Rate with the GROUND TRUTH ACTION HISTORY PROVIDED at every step
WebShop: Task Score = 100 x average reward reported jointly with Success Rate (r = 1) over a 500-instance test split
AgentBench: per-environment Success Rate with an estimated #Avg. Turn, over 8 heterogeneous environments

unresolved: U-1 Whether the frozen Part 1 question has a positive or negative answer in the published literature is NOT settled by this packet. Within the corpus actually reached, the single artifact that reports the cost-accounting construct reports NO break-even reuse count, a MODELED numerator, a MODELED three-arm dollar table and an unquantified staleness surface, and its own live in-loop saving is about 14% against a modeled 83.3%. That is evidence about one artifact on one person's corpus, not a literature-level verdict, and gate 1 forbids adopting it as one.

U-2 The correct arXiv identifiers for BrowserGym, MiniWoB++ and SeeAct are unknown to this run, which was forbidden from searching for them because the frozen list is the corpus. The Smallest next action that would unblock this: a director mandate permitting an identifier repair pass whose only permitted mutation is replacing a frozen arXiv ID that provably resolves to an unrelated artifact, with every repair logged and the identity rule unchanged.

U-3 The Part 1 construct population inside the frozen list is 0 (VN-5). The smallest next action: a director mandate that restates the Part 1 target population as systems that actually persist state across sessions or episodes, and authorizes a corpus search for that population, since the frozen list of benchmarks cannot answer the frozen Part 1 question at any identity recall.

U-4 The bounded snowball could not be executed under its own frozen inclusion rule (VN-4). The smallest next action: a director mandate permitting the snowball to fall back to resolving reference entries by author-title-year against the Semantic Scholar graph API, which returned HTTP 200 on this run's substrate probe (OBS-1), with the identity rule unchanged. The candidate entries already visible in the PC artifact's bibliography are 'Agent workflow memory' and 'Position: Episodic memory is the missing piece for long-term LLM agents'.

U-5 Whether a published system anywhere reports a MEASURED break-even reuse count with denominator, accounting convention and uncertainty is genuinely unknown here, because the searched corpus was 5 benchmarks plus 1 memory paper. No estimate of the prevalence of such reporting is available and none is offered.

U-6 Whether the title-condition reading chosen in VN-3 is the reading a downstream auditor and director consider binding. This single implementation decision changes identity_resolution_recall between 0.0 and 0.357 and changes Parts 2 and 3 between INCONCLUSIVE-by-recall and INCONCLUSIVE-by-zero-recall. It does not change the overall MEASUREMENT_INVALID, which rests on gate 1 independently.

U-7 Whether the Part 2 envelope is a real spread or an artifact of the frozen list's benchmark-era composition is unknown. The four rates retrieved span 1.1% to 59.1% but under four different conventions, four different model tiers and four different date ranges, and none of the 5 correctly resolved artifacts is a memory-augmented or workflow-inducing agent, so the director mandate's actual comparison target (published memory-augmented web agents) was not reached by the frozen corpus at all.

U-8 Whether the arXiv Atom API 406 (OBS-1) is persistent or was triggered by this runner's egress. It does not affect this packet's validity because the abs/PDF transport returned the same authoritative citation metadata, but it does affect any future design that freezes the Atom endpoint as its retrieval channel.
validity_notes: VN-1 MEASUREMENT-STATUS SEMANTICS. status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID. This is a measurement-validity failure, NOT a scientific falsification and NOT an infrastructure failure. No claim about the existence or absence of published break-even reuse counts is licensed by this packet.

VN-2 THE BINDING INVALID TRIGGER. prereg section 7 gate 1 fires because PC-COST-ACCOUNTING cannot pass: prereg 6.1 requires extraction from an artifact that passes the prereg 4.1 identity resolution, and arXiv:2608.05784v1 cannot pass it while spec.json freezes expected_authors=['TBD'] for that entry. The failure is in the frozen TARGET LIST, not in the resolver: the resolver correctly refused a target whose frozen expected author identity does not exist. The producer did not add an 'author list unavailable' branch, because doing so after observing this outcome would be a post-hoc change to a frozen identity contract that flips the experiment verdict.

VN-3 NO PREREGISTRATION WAS WEAKENED. The three substitutions actually made are recorded in provenance.json deviations_from_frozen_design: (a) arXiv abs/PDF transport in place of the blocked arXiv Atom API, which changes the retrieval channel and not the identity assertion; (b) a base-identifier re-probe of the two targets whose 404 was caused by a non-existent version suffix, which removed a transport artifact without relaxing any identity condition; (c) the title condition read as a case-insensitive substring test with a token-coverage threshold, because a full-token-set Jaccard of 0.85 is arithmetically unsatisfiable for a 1-2 token expected title against any real arXiv title. Both Jaccard and coverage values are logged per target so an auditor can recompute under either reading; under the strict full-set-Jaccard reading identity_resolution_recall would be 0.0 and Parts 1-3 would all be INCONCLUSIVE, which strengthens rather than weakens the conclusion that this frozen list cannot decide the science.

VN-4 SNOWBALL NOT EXECUTED AS FROZEN. prereg 4.4's bounded snowball was ATTEMPTED and returned 0 candidates because the frozen inclusion rule requires arXiv identifiers inside reference strings and the PC artifact prints none. No substitute search was run: using a different retrieval strategy to find persistent-state web agents would be a post-hoc corpus change, so the uncovered space is reported as uncovered rather than filled.

VN-5 CORPUS-CONSTRUCT MISMATCH, UNFROZEN. The frozen list of 14 named systems is a list of BENCHMARKS AND ENVIRONMENTS. None of the 5 correctly resolved targets reports persistent state across sessions or episodes, so the Part 1 construct population is 0 regardless of identity recall. identity_resolution_recall measures name-to-artifact identity and is therefore not a coverage metric for the Part 1 construct; the frozen gate 5 uses it as if it were. The derived count is reported as p1_n_correctly_resolved_targets_persisting_state_across_sessions = 0, computed by a declared keyword probe (persistent_state_construct) over title and abstract plus full text, and it is a derived measurement, not a frozen metric.

VN-6 SUB-VALIDITY OF THE RECORDED QUANTITIES. Because gate 1 fires, every Part 1, Part 2 and Part 3 quantity in metrics is recorded as evidence of what the artifacts say, at a claim ceiling of 'verbatim from a named artifact, denominators exposed, modeled quantities labelled'. None of them is a valid, packet-adopted measurement of the director mandate's question, because the frozen part-level INCONCLUSIVE/MEASUREMENT_INVALID verdicts stand.

VN-7 MODELED QUANTITIES ARE LABELLED, NOT CONVERTED. Every modeled quantity carries modeled_vs_measured and an accounting_convention stating the modeling assumption, per the mandate's output contract. p1_routine_overhead_ratio_R_*_x are MODELED numerators over measured denominators from an n=1 passive-capture corpus of one professional over 51 active days; they are a report about one person, not a bound on SPIDER's economics, and this packet does not use them as one.

VN-8 PDF TEXT-LAYER REPRESENTATION LOSS. Field evidence quotes are whitespace-normalized slices of the arXiv PDF text layer, which drops ligatures, de-hyphenates across line breaks and does not linearise table cells. Two consequences: (a) a missing number may be present in a figure or table cell the text layer did not linearise, which is why the AgentBench-web headline rate is reported as NOT_REPORTED rather than as a number; (b) a present number may appear with broken spacing. The retrieval scope and the character count searched are recorded on every absence determination so the absence claim is auditable at the strength the instrument actually supports ('absent from the retrieved text', not 'absent from the paper').

VN-9 FROZEN-LIST IDENTIFIER DEFECTS ARE REPORTED, NOT REPAIRED. Three frozen entries that the prereg did NOT declare as placeholders carry arXiv identifiers that resolve to unrelated real papers (BrowserGym 2401.15378, MiniWoB++ 1802.08827, SeeAct 2402.04566). They were left UNMEASURED. Correcting them requires a director mandate because the frozen list is the corpus definition; see unresolved.

VN-10 THE COVERAGE METRIC CAN VARY. identity_resolution_recall is computed as correctly_resolved / named_systems_searched over a denominator that is a constant 14, and it returned 0.3571, so the metric is not the degenerate searched/mandated ratio the parent packet was failed for. It is nevertheless a weak instrument: it conflates corpus design errors (placeholder and wrong identifiers) with resolver failure, and both are present here.

VN-11 NO INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION OF ANY PUBLISHED NUMBER. Every value in the table is read from a published artifact. Nothing was reproduced. The prereg section 10 scope explicitly excludes reproduction, so this is by design, but it means the envelope is a report of what papers claim, not a measurement of what those systems do.

VN-12 PART 2 CONVENTION COMPARABILITY IS PARTIAL, NOT ABSENT. WebVoyager states that it follows the WebArena evaluation convention by design, so those two are comparable to each other. Mind2Web, WebShop and AgentBench are not comparable to either. The frozen Part 2 SUPPORTS clause asks whether a COMMON convention enables direct comparison across the benchmark family, which the evidence does not establish; the frozen rule nevertheless assigns INCONCLUSIVE because gate 5 fires first.

VN-13 THIS IS A PRODUCER SELF-CHECK, NOT AN AUDIT. validate_packet.py re-hashes the frozen inputs and checks the packet shape. It is not the independent audit required by research/EXPERIMENT_PACKET.md section 6, and no claim here is self-promoted.

VN-14 THE MANDATE'S REUSABLE-ARTIFACT DEPENDENCY IS PARTIALLY MET. The identity-resolution instrument, the frozen matching rule and the four controls are published as code plus raw evidence at exact repository-relative paths with sha256 hashes in artifacts. They are NOT published 'at an exact commit' because branch discipline in this session forbids git commit; provenance.json records the working-tree HEAD so a later commit can pin them.
